title: extract-hook-templates-and-add-strict-values-schema-for-private-installer
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Helm: extract reusable hook module templates; add values.schema.json for strict validation in Private installer; introduce opt-in tenant-scoped hook sequencing and backwards-compatible aliases; documentation updates for upgrade path.
description:
Motivation: Private installations have accumulated ad-hoc Helm hooks and hand-rolled initJobs across tenant templates. This makes upgrades brittle and values validation inconsistent between deployments. This PR extracts hook templates into a small reusable 'hook modules' layer, adds a Helm values.schema.json to validate private installer config, and provides aliasing to avoid breaking existing installs. The goal is safer upgrades (clearer validation), easier composition of hook phases (init/pre/post), and a smaller mental model for operators.

What I changed (high level): consolidated init/tenant hooks into templates/hooks/modules.yaml and templates/hooks/_helpers.tpl; added charts/redwood-private/values.schema.json with JSONSchema for the private.* keys; introduced values.private.hooks.modules to declare per-tenant hook phases (preflight, init, migrate, cleanup) and per-module timeouts; added values.private.hooks.enabled boolean and backwards-compatible values.private.hooks_timeout -> private.hooks.timeouts aliasing so old installs keep their behavior; updated README and UPGRADE_NOTES with an upgrade checklist and example values snippets; small Terraform bump in infra/modules/helm_private to propagate new top-level values.

Checklist: [x] extract reusable templates, [x] add schema to chart, [x] add aliases for compatibility, [x] update docs, [x] add unit tests for template rendering, [x] run canary deployment in perf CI.

Commits summary: see commits field for each commit message. Changes are intentionally small inside each commit: template extraction, schema authoring, alias compatibility, docs and tests.

Files changed (high level): templates/hooks/modules.yaml, templates/hooks/_helpers.tpl, values.schema.json, Chart.yaml (chart version bump), values.yaml (new shape + aliases), README-PRIVATE.md (upgrade notes), ci/templates/test-render.sh (unit test update), infra/modules/helm_private/main.tf (tiny variable pass-through), tests/helm/templates/hooks_test.go (render tests).

Testing and CI: branch ran through standard CI (lint, unit-template-render, helm unit tests, integration canary). Initial run had a transient kube client timeout in integration; restart of the integration job passed. All required checks passed before merging.

Review summary and rationale for acceptance: reviewers requested a stricter schema (Lena), clearer alias docs (Arjun) and a small runtime opt-out switch for shops that still manage hooks externally (Tomás). Author addressed comments by tightening schema enums for hook phases, adding examples for migration of values.private.hooks_timeout to the new nested timeouts block, and adding a one-line note about helm template --validate behavior in README. Reviewers approved with suggestions; no blocking concerns remained.

Upgrade guidance (short): bump chart to the new patch, run helm get values to capture existing hooks.* keys, apply migration snippet from UPGRADE_NOTES to map old timeout values into private.hooks.timeouts, run helm template --validate to ensure JSONSchema passes, then perform a canary upgrade per existing docs.

Merge: Squash merge into main after two approvals and CI green. The change is backwards-compatible by default via aliases; however operators are encouraged to adopt the stricter schema to catch misconfigurations before upgrades.
